_about: Pell's name as his clutch would whistle it, carved on the Act III name-shell (pell.md §3, art decision on the Kirru whistle-click speech, §12 Q4 carried with this default): a spiral of notches from the rim to the centre, long (`L`) and short (`S`), in the order of the whistle. Never letters of any script. pell_textures draws the carving on the `shell_carved` island from these numbers: `turns` round the shell, the spiral from `r_outer` to `r_inner` (fractions of the shell's radius), each notch `long_frac` or `short_frac` of the spiral's pitch deep across the groove and `width_deg` wide along it, with `gap_deg` between notches.
_scratch_about: the blank shell's faint radial scratches where the old carving was ground off (bible §8: 'ground blank'), seeded
